mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during this phase, or the 20d returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) compared to a baseline period.

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt increase in the unemployment rate above 5% in a single month signals weakening labor market strength, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 instances of such UNRATE spikes, or the 5d returns fail to exceed -2% in magnitude.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month averages signals robust demand across sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous 12mo avg AND HOUST > previous 12mo avg
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 instances where both proxies meet the trigger condition, or the returns fail to exceed +1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% month-over-month for three consecutive months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the regime is not correctly identified by the regime detection model.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (monetary tightening) and decline in quarterly GDP (demand contraction) signals contractionary policy, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% AND GDPC1 falls > 5% in a month
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 instances where both proxies meet the trigger, or the returns fail to drop below -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 in a single month signals labor market overheating, prompting market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 instances of such payroll spikes, or the 5d returns fail to drop below -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 60% of supply-side expansion periods, or the returns fail to exceed +1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During an expanding demand cycle, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 350,000 in a month signals strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 75% of expanding demand periods, or the regime is not correctly detected by the regime model.
